label: CSIA Flight Assurance PRIME-1: what the Analyzer supports, as a product contract. Every entry names its validation level and evidence. No entry is PHYSICAL_VALIDATED: no physical evidence exists yet. Do not claim generic PX4 support.

validation_levels.SIMULATION: shown in PX4 software-in-the-loop simulation (SIH quadrotor) only
validation_levels.REAL_LOG_CONTEXT_ONLY: real logs are read and their coverage stated; no diagnostic conclusion has been checked against real truth
validation_levels.PHYSICAL_VALIDATED: a diagnostic conclusion checked against independent physical truth (none yet)

product_boundary.kind: offboard analysis of PX4 ULogs (SITL, HIL, flight test, incident replay)

states.SUPPORTED: vehicle, PX4 version, schema, topics and logging all inside a supported configuration
states.PARTIAL: the analysis runs; some evidence is missing, refused or untested for this configuration (each reason listed)
states.UNKNOWN_VERSION: the log does not say which PX4 version produced it; the analysis runs with every conclusion qualified
states.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA: the log cannot be read as a PX4 ULog with the topics any analysis needs; only log integrity is reported
states.UNSUPPORTED_VEHICLE_CONFIGURATION: the vehicle is outside every profile; no diagnostic interpretation is made; only generic analysis is reported

configurations.vehicle: multirotor quadrotor, X configuration (vehicle_status.vehicle_type 1, CA_ROTOR_COUNT 4, not VTOL)

optional_topics.battery_status: battery context; current needed for power records

minimum_rates.note: 3 x PX4 547e2ca's default logging interval; propulsion topics at >= 5 Hz kept every confirmation in PRIME's stress envelope (SITL)

hypotheses: COMMAND_NO_RESPONSE per motor: ACTUATION/drive_no_current, ACTUATION/mechanical, COMMUNICATION/command_not_delivered, POWER/path_unavailable, SENSOR/response_sensor
configurations.evidence: 2.3 validation flights V1-V13; RB-001 flights; XSYS-001; PRIME-1 held-out evaluation (research/csia_prime1/)

configurations.vehicle: as quadx-allocation-esc, without ESC RPM telemetry
configurations.effect: no propulsion evidence and no propulsion event discovery; PX4 monitor events, battery and EKF2 context only
configurations.evidence: 2.3 synthetic esc=False logs; PRIME support check

configurations.vehicle: quad X on PX4 before control allocation (actuator_controls_0 / actuator_outputs only)
configurations.effect: no propulsion evidence; PX4 monitor events and battery context only
configurations.evidence: RB-001 RB0 (real boards); PRIME RR-11 (RflyMAD's real-flight topic descriptor)

configurations.vehicle: hexa-, octo-, tri- or coaxial multirotor (CA_ROTOR_COUNT != 4)

configurations.evidence: real FMUv5 boat log (PX4 documentation sample); PRIME RR-09

configurations.vehicle: any log that is not a PX4 ULog (e.g. ArduPilot .bin, .tlog)

generic_analysis_when_withheld: log integrity: topics present, logging gaps, logger dropouts
PX4's own warnings, failsafes and failure-detector flags, as a timeline (re-raised identical conditions grouped)
PX4 version, hardware and airframe as recorded

rpm_shortfall.supported: discovered (RPM_DEFICIT_EVENT) and reported as telemetry evidence; never a motor fault on its own

rpm_excess.supported: discovered (RPM_EXCESS_EVENT) and reported as telemetry evidence (PRIME-1; D-PRIME-2)

esc_offline.supported: discovered (ESC_OFFLINE_EVENT); telemetry UNAVAILABLE, never read as a deficit

log_dropout.supported: evidence over the gap refused; support PARTIAL

stuck_value.supported: NOT discovered in steady hover (no change to see); see the telemetry matrix

static_offset_or_slow_drift.supported: NOT discovered as a change; a gross static inconsistency with the other rotors is stated as a coverage notice

matched_physical_vs_telemetry_discrimina.supported: in simulation only; physical test designed, not run

known_blind_spots: losses during continuous maneuvering are discovered but not confirmed (the compensation witness needs steady flight)
ESC current not logged by stock PX4: drive-without-current and stall cannot be separated
battery current often not logged: the power path cannot be eliminated
a propeller loss that leaves RPM unchanged has only the compensation witness
compute and timing faults, command-delivery faults
a compensation change between two steady holds at different headings is not an event, but its evidence is not yet refused (candidate validity condition)
every threshold is SITL-calibrated (SIH has almost no noise); real vehicles need their own nominal calibration

known_defects.summary: sub-microsecond time representation changed admissibility decisions
an RPM excess opened no event; a late event read a corrupted reference as NOMINAL

known_defects.affected: every wheel before PRIME-1, including PRIME's participant bundle
known_defects.summary: the wheel omitted stock_calibration.json: an installed csia-assure crashed on every analysable log
